heads.t: 唯一敢踩煞車的人！輝達臨時CEO克雷斯起底 曾砍老黃「千億豪賭」 輝達（Nvidia）共同創辦人黃仁勳（Jensen Huang）12日因涉入婚外情醜聞請辭，結束長達30年的掌舵生涯。在董事會尋找正式接班人之際，現年59歲的財務長克雷斯（Colette Kress）臨危受命出任暫代執行長。《路透社》揭露，克雷斯過去多年來是輝達內部少數敢踩煞車的高層，曾多次擋下黃仁勳高風險的千億美元AI豪賭，如今在動盪時刻接下重擔，一舉一動備受華爾街矚目。 19 分鐘前｜國際 唯一敢踩煞車的人！輝達臨時CEO克雷斯起底 曾砍老黃「千億豪賭」 19 分鐘前｜國際
heads.en: The only person who dared to step on the brakes! Fabulously, CEO Crixus rose up and cut down the old “billions of bets” and Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang resigned from the marriage scandal on 12 days, ending his 30-year-old ruddering career. As the board seeks an official successor, the current 59-year-old chief finance officer, Colette Kress, is in danger of being appointed as interim executive director. According to Reuters, Crixus, a few years ago, a few high-ranking man who dared to hit a brake on his car, and who had repeatedly stood up to Huang In-hoon’s high-risk bets, took over the burden at the moment of the crash, with every move under Wall Street. 19 minutes ago, the only man who dared to step on the brakes!
